groups.label: Articles — A, AN, THE & Zero Article
groups.definition: Determiners modifying nouns to indicate general (A/AN), specific (THE), or broad category (Zero Article) references.
rules: A: before consonant sounds (a book, a university).
AN: before vowel sounds (an apple, an hour).
THE: for specific, previously mentioned, or unique items (the sun, the CEO).
Zero Article: for general plurals, uncountables, meals, languages, cities, and countries.

examples.t: The sun rises in the east.

groups.label: Quantifiers — Some, Any, Much, Many, A lot of
groups.definition: Determiners expressing quantity or degree before countable and uncountable nouns.
rules: Some: positive statements and polite offers/requests (I have some water. Would you like some coffee?).
Any: negative statements and general questions (I don't have any money. Are there any questions?).
Much: uncountable nouns in negative/questions (Not much time).

examples.t: We have some apples in the kitchen.
